$comment: Golden cases of the system options (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py): the default model (auto scale, the dark theme chosen, its color slots at their defaults); custom-scale: a saved 110% shown as its own choice, reduced motion and reduced effects on, classic chosen (no color slots), the other legacy choices moved; colors: an accent and 80% panel opacity set, the resolve's adjusted note shown (the player's colors applied, --colors); no-effects: a device without effects, the toggle on and locked with its note (--no-effects). The frames are 1000dp tall so the whole window shows (it scrolls on a shorter screen). translucent: modern-dark and modern-light at 80% panel opacity over the synthetic backdrop (docs/ui/snapshots/backdrop.png), the frame blurring what is behind it (P13 spec 7.7).
